Act3-2#1.zh: 你这个死贼寇！今日落到我的手中，还有什么话可说？！
Act3-2#1.t: You filthy bandit! Now you're in my hands, what have you got to say?!

Act3-2#2.zh: 要杀就杀吧！反正二十年后又是一条好汉！
Act3-2#2.t: Kill me if you want! In twenty years I'll be back as another hero!

Act3-2#3.t: Still talking big at death's door!

Act3-2#4.zh: 贤弟不要生气。你现在杀了这个强盗，只不过是弄脏了史家的地板；倒不如送去官府还可领赏...
Act3-2#4.t: Don't be angry, brother. Kill this robber now and you'll only dirty the Shi family's floor. Better to hand him to the magistrate and collect the reward...

Act3-2#5.zh: 哼！就暂且把你的头寄放在你的脖子上！等到我把其他两人一齐捉住，再一同送上官府！
Act3-2#5.t: Hmph! Your head can stay on your neck for now! Once I've caught the other two, I'll hand you all over to the magistrate together!

Act3-2#6.zh: 大郎，少华山头领朱武、杨春求见。
Act3-2#6.t: Young master, the Mount Shaohua chiefs Zhu Wu and Yang Chun ask to see you.

Act3-2#7.zh: 什么？他们自己送上门了？
Act3-2#7.t: What? They've walked right into my hands?

Act3-2#8.t: ...No harm in seeing them. Bring them in.

Act3-2#9.zh: 吾弟冒犯虎威，今日特地来负荆请罪。吾等恶贯满盈，不求史公恕罪，只求一同将我等送至官府！
Act3-2#9.t: My brother offended you, mighty sir. Today we come to beg your pardon with thorns on our backs. We are steeped in crimes and ask no mercy from you, only that you send us to the magistrate together with him!

Act3-2#11.zh: 我虽然是粗鲁人，但是也还知道什么叫做义气。当初与哥哥两人因官司缠身，不得已上山落草。当初发誓『不求同日生，但愿同日死』；虽然比不上刘关张的英雄，但是也不能放着哥哥不管独自偷生啊！
Act3-2#11.t: I may be a rough man, but I still know what loyalty means. My brother and I were caught up in lawsuits and had no choice but to become outlaws. We swore, "Though not born on the same day, we will die on the same day". We're no heroes like Liu, Guan and Zhang, but I can't abandon my brother to save my own skin!

Act3-2#12.zh: 今日小弟陈达不听规劝，竟敢太岁头上动土；反被英雄擒住。某不才，无力救出手足兄弟，岂有面目见江东父老？今日特来求死，希望英雄将我等三人一同解送官府领赏，以应同生共死之誓。我等能死于英雄手中，并无怨言！
Act3-2#12.t: My younger brother Chen Da ignored our advice and dared to provoke you, and a hero captured him. I am useless. I could not rescue my sworn brother, so how could I face anyone back home? We have come today to die. We ask you, hero, to deliver all three of us to the magistrate and claim the reward, so that we keep our vow to live and die together. To die at a hero's hands is no shame to us!

Act3-2#14.zh: (多讲义气的好汉啊！我要是把他们送到官府领赏，岂不叫天下英雄笑话？)
Act3-2#14.t: (What loyal, honourable men! If I sent them to the magistrate for a reward, every hero in the land would laugh at me!)

Act3-2#15.zh: 大郎，原本只能赚一千贯，现在另外两千贯也自己送上门来啦！小人马上拿绳索把这两个土匪捉起来！
Act3-2#15.t: Young master, we were only going to make a thousand strings, and now the other two thousand have walked right in! I'll fetch rope and tie up these two bandits at once!

Act3-2#19.zh: 你们如此义气深重，我如果把你们送了官府，那就不是好汉。我把陈达还给你们，如何？
Act3-2#19.t: You are so loyal that if I handed you over, I'd be no hero at all. I'll give Chen Da back to you. How about it?

Act3-2#20.zh: 只怕连累史公吃上官司；还是把我们送官府比较妥当。
Act3-2#20.t: We're only afraid you'll get into trouble with the law, Master Shi. It would be safer to hand us over.

Act3-2#21.zh: 不用多说。我摆一桌宴席招待好汉，你们愿意赏光吗？
Act3-2#21.t: Say no more. I'll lay on a feast for you heroes. Will you do me the honour?

Act3-2#22.zh: 死都不怕了，难道还怕喝酒吗？哈哈哈....
Act3-2#22.t: We weren't afraid to die, so why be afraid of a drink? Ha ha ha....

Act3-2#24.zh: 英雄惜英雄，史进放了陈达，并与三人结交。
Act3-2#24.t: Hero recognised hero. Shi Jin freed Chen Da and became friends with all three.
